product_one_liner.value: Jack & Jill uses AI agents to help jobseekers find suitable roles and companies recruit candidates, connecting matched candidates directly with hiring managers.

employee_band.notes: The company states that it has 28 people.

hq_location.notes: The company also lists a San Francisco office.

founded_year.notes: Air Street Capital says the founders started Jack & Jill in March 2025, consistent with their profiles; the company's llms.txt conflicts by listing 2024.

eng_blog.notes: The blog contains product announcements, hiring advice and company news, rather than two qualifying engineer-authored posts about building the product.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation includes getting started, candidate discovery and integration guides.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: None of the nine listed openings has a qualifying AI, ML or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: The Platform Terms name these providers in the subcontractor-policy clause; specific model versions are not stated.

compliance_certs.notes: The reviewed privacy policy names none of the five requested certifications or compliance frameworks.

raised_18mo.notes: The $40 million Series A announced on 15 September 2026 falls within the requested window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: An Account Executive opening in San Francisco has an application link.

launched_6mo.notes: Company Insights launched in Jill on 4 November 2026, adding company growth, hiring and retention context to candidate histories.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Franky Athill's profile lists his CMO / Founding Team tenure at Jack & Jill as ending in August 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable Account Executive and GTM Engineer postings name no CRM or sales/marketing platform.
